ask_gec.description: Grammar correction based on the ASK-GEC dataset. The main metric is ERRANT F0.5, which emphasizes precision over recall in grammar correction tasks.

ncb.description: Linguistic acceptability based on the NCB dataset, which focuses on correct placement of commas. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.5.

nocola.description: Linguistic acceptability based on the BLiMP-like NoCoLA dataset, which includes a variety of linguistic phenomena. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.5.

norbelebele.description: Reading comprehension based on the NorBelebele dataset, which includes questions about a given passage. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.25.

norcommonsenseqa_nno.description: Commonsense question-answering based on the NorCommonsenseQA dataset, which includes multiple-choice questions that require commonsense reasoning. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.2.

norcommonsenseqa_nob.description: Commonsense question-answering based on the NorCommonsenseQA dataset, which includes multiple-choice questions that require commonsense reasoning. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.2.

norec_document.description: Binary document-level sentiment analysis based on the NoReC dataset. The main metric is F1 score, with a random baseline of 0.5.

norec_sentence.description: Binary sentence-level sentiment analysis based on the NoReC dataset. The main metric is F1 score, with a random baseline of 0.5.

noreval_multiblimp.description: Linguistic-acceptability test for Northern Sámi based on the MultiBLiMP dataset, a multilingual benchmark of minimal pairs. For Northern Sámi, it tests subject-verb and subject-participle agreement for person (1st/2nd/3rd) and number (singular/dual/plural). The agreement is tested on finite verbs, auxiliaries, and participles. The model must assign higher probability to the grammatical sentence in each minimal pair. The main metric is micro-averaged accuracy across all subtasks, with a random baseline of 0.5.

1-2.description: Correct sentence has 1st person agreement; distractor has 2nd person. Mostly subject-participle agreement (n=24).

1-3.description: Correct sentence has 1st person agreement; distractor has 3rd person. Mostly subject-participle agreement (n=24).

1-23.description: Correct sentence has 1st person agreement; distractor has 2nd or 3rd person. Subject-participle agreement (n=2).

2-1.description: Correct sentence has 2nd person agreement; distractor has 1st person. Subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=75).

2-3.description: Correct sentence has 2nd person agreement; distractor has 3rd person. Subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=84).

3-1.description: Correct sentence has 3rd person agreement; distractor has 1st person. Subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=380).

3-2.description: Correct sentence has 3rd person agreement; distractor has 2nd person. Subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=371).

SG-PL.description: Correct sentence has singular agreement; distractor has plural. Mostly subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=356).

PL-SG.description: Correct sentence has plural agreement; distractor has singular. Subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=341).

SG-DU.description: Correct sentence has singular agreement; distractor has dual. Mostly subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=373).

DU-SG.description: Correct sentence has dual agreement; distractor has singular. Subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=89).

PL-DU.description: Correct sentence has plural agreement; distractor has dual. Subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=333).

DU-PL.description: Correct sentence has dual agreement; distractor has plural. Subject-verb agreement on finite verbs and auxiliaries (n=84).

noridiom_nno.description: Idiom completion based on the NorIdiom dataset, the model is given the first N-1 words of an idiom and must generate the completion. The main metric is em_first (exact match of the first generated word against the correct completion word), with a random baseline of 0.0. Additional metrics include em (exact match of the full completion) and fscore (token overlap F1).

noridiom_nob.description: Idiom completion based on the NorIdiom dataset, the model is given the first N-1 words of an idiom and must generate the completion. The main metric is em_first (exact match of the first generated word against the correct completion word), with a random baseline of 0.0. Additional metrics include em (exact match of the full completion) and fscore (token overlap F1).

noropenbookqa_nno.description: Reading comprehension based on the NorOpenBookQA dataset, which includes multiple-choice questions about a given factual statement. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.25.

noropenbookqa_nob.description: Reading comprehension based on the NorOpenBookQA dataset, which includes multiple-choice questions about a given factual statement. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.25.

noropenbookqa_no_fact_nno.description: Openbook question-answering based on the NorOpenBookQA dataset, but without the factual statement provided. The model must rely on its own knowledge to answer the questions. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.25.

noropenbookqa_no_fact_nob.description: Openbook question-answering based on the NorOpenBookQA dataset, but without the factual statement provided. The model must rely on its own knowledge to answer the questions. The main metric is accuracy, with a random baseline of 0.25.

norquad.description: Reading comprehension based on the NorQuAD dataset, which includes questions about a given passage. The main metric is F1 score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must predict specific spans of text.

norrewrite_instruct.description: Instruction-following based on the NorRewrite dataset, which includes tasks where the model must rewrite a given text according to specific instructions. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

norsummarize_instruct.description: Summarization based on the NorSummarize dataset, which includes tasks where the model must summarize a given text according to specific instructions. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

norsumm_nob.description: Summarization based on the NorSumm dataset, which includes tasks where the model must summarize a given text. The main metric is ROUGE-L, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

norsumm_nno.description: Summarization based on the NorSumm dataset, which includes tasks where the model must summarize a given text. The main metric is ROUGE-L, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

norsumm_nob_nno_translation.description: Translation based on the NorSumm dataset, the model has to translate paragraphs between Nynorsk and Bokmål. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

norsumm_nno_nob_translation.description: Translation based on the NorSumm dataset, the model has to translate paragraphs between Nynorsk and Bokmål. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

nortruthfulqa_gen_nno.description: Generative question-answering based on the TruthfulQA dataset, which includes questions questions that some humans would answer falsely due to a false belief or misconception. The model must generate an answer to each question, and the main metric is ROUGE-L, which measures the overlap between the generated answer and reference answers. The random baseline is 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

nortruthfulqa_gen_nob.description: Generative question-answering based on the TruthfulQA dataset, which includes questions questions that some humans would answer falsely due to a false belief or misconception. The model must generate an answer to each question, and the main metric is ROUGE-L, which measures the overlap between the generated answer and reference answers. The random baseline is 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

nortruthfulqa_mc_nno.description: Multiple-choice question-answering based on the TruthfulQA dataset, which includes questions that some humans would answer falsely due to a false belief or misconception. The model must select the correct answer from multiple choices, and the main metric is accuracy. The random baseline is approximately 0.233 since the model must choose the correct answer from multiple options.

nortruthfulqa_mc_nob.description: Multiple-choice question-answering based on the TruthfulQA dataset, which includes questions that some humans would answer falsely due to a false belief or misconception. The model must select the correct answer from multiple choices, and the main metric is accuracy.

nrk_quiz_qa_nno.description: Multiple-choice question-answering based on the NRK quiz dataset. The model must select the correct answer from multiple choices, and the main metric is accuracy. The random baseline is approximately 0.279 since the model must choose the correct answer from multiple options.

nrk_quiz_qa_nob.description: Multiple-choice question-answering based on the NRK quiz dataset. The model must select the correct answer from multiple choices, and the main metric is accuracy.

slide.description: Language identification based on the multi-labeled SLIDE dataset, which includes sentences in various Scandinavian languages. The model must identify the language of each sentence, and the main metric is accuracy. The random baseline is approximately 0.213 since there are multiple languages to choose from.

tatoeba_eng_nno.description: Translation based on the Tatoeba dataset, the model has to translate sentences between Nynorsk and English. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

tatoeba_eng_nob.description: Translation based on the Tatoeba dataset, the model has to translate sentences between Norwegian Bokmål and English. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

tatoeba_nno_eng.description: Translation based on the Tatoeba dataset, the model has to translate sentences between Nynorsk and English. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

tatoeba_nob_eng.description: Translation based on the Tatoeba dataset, the model has to translate sentences between Norwegian Bokmål and English. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

tatoeba_nob_sme.description: Translation based on the Tatoeba dataset, the model has to translate sentences between Norwegian Bokmål and Northern Sámi. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

tatoeba_sme_nob.description: Translation based on the Tatoeba dataset, the model has to translate sentences between Norwegian Bokmål and Northern Sámi. The main metric is BLEU score, with a random baseline of 0.0 since the model must generate specific text.

norolmo-13b.description: Fully-open Norwegian language model continually-trained on OLMo2 (13B stage 2), trained by the Language Technology Group at the University of Oslo.

norolmo-13b-stage1.description: The final stage-1 checkpoint of NorOLMo-13B (after 24,000 steps). NorOLMo is a fully-open Norwegian language model continually-trained on OLMo2, trained by the Language Technology Group at the University of Oslo.

normistral-7b-warm.description: Norwegian language model initialized from Mistral-7B-v0.1 and continually-trained on 260 billion subword tokens of Norwegian data. Trained by the Language Technology Group at the University of Oslo.

normistral-11b-warm.description: Norwegian language model based on Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407, continually-trained on 250 billion tokens of Norwegian, Scandinavian, Sámi and code data. Trained by the Language Technology Group at the University of Oslo.

normistral-11b-long.description: Norwegian language model with extended context length (32k→128k tokens), based on normistral-11b-warm.

norbert4-xlarge.description: The fourth generation NorBERT model for Norwegian encoding/decoding. Trained from scratch on 600B tokens of Norwegian Bokmål, Nynorsk and Northern Sámi. Trained by the Language Technology Group at the University of Oslo.

NorGPT-3B.description: Generative pretrained transformer for Norwegian based on GPT-2 architecture. Part of the NorGLM suite trained on ~25B tokens.

NorLlama-3B.description: Generative pretrained transformer for Norwegian based on LLaMA architecture. Part of the NorGLM suite.

NorwAI-Mistral-7B.description: Model continually-trained on Mistral-7B-v0.1 using 51B tokens of Norwegian and Nordic data. Part of the NorwAI LLM family from NTNU. Restricted to use within Nordic countries.

NorwAI-Mixtral-8x7B.description: MoE model continually-trained on Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1 using 51B tokens of Norwegian and Nordic data. Part of the NorwAI LLM family from NTNU. Restricted to use within Nordic countries.

nb-gpt-j-6B.description: Norwegian fine-tuned version of GPT-J. Part of the NB's effort to create Norwegian language models.

nb-gpt-j-6B-v2.description: An improved version of NB-GPT-J 6B by the National Library of Norway, but without any information about the model or the training data.

OLMo-2-0425-1B.description: Open language model from the Allen Institute for AI trained on 4 trillion tokens.

olmo-2-13b (stage 1).description: The last stage-1 checkpoint of OLMo 2, an open language model trained on 5 trillion tokens by the Allen Institute for AI.

OLMo-2-1124-13B.description: Open language model from the Allen Institute for AI trained on 5 trillion tokens.

Olmo-3-1025-7B.description: Open language model from the Allen Institute for AI trained on 5.93 trillion tokens with 65k context length.

Olmo-3-1025-7B-stage1.description: The last stage-1 checkpoint of OLMo3 7B, an open language model from the Allen Institute for AI trained on 5.93 trillion tokens with 65k context length.

Olmo-3-1125-32B.description: Open language model from the Allen Institute for AI trained on 5.50 trillion tokens with 65k context length.

Apertus-8B-2509.description: Multilingual model supporting over 1000 languages, designed for fully-open and transparent language modeling. Trained on 15T tokens.

Apertus-8B-2509-stage1.description: Stage-1 version of Apertus 8B. Multilingual model supporting over 1000 languages, designed for fully-open and transparent language modeling. Trained on 13.5T tokens.

Apertus-8B-2509-stage2.description: Stage-2 version of Apertus 8B. Multilingual model supporting over 1000 languages, designed for fully-open and transparent language modeling. Trained on 13.5T tokens.

Apertus-8B-2509-stage3.description: Stage-3 version of Apertus 8B. Multilingual model supporting over 1000 languages, designed for fully-open and transparent language modeling. Trained on 13.5T tokens.

Apertus-8B-2509-stage4.description: Stage-4 version (before final high-quality training) of Apertus 8B. Multilingual model supporting over 1000 languages, designed for fully-open and transparent language modeling. Trained on 13.5T tokens.

Apertus-8B-2509-stage5.description: Stage-5 version (before length extension) of Apertus 8B. Multilingual model supporting over 1000 languages, designed for fully-open and transparent language modeling. Trained on 13.5T tokens.

Apertus-70B-2509.description: Multilingual model supporting over 1000 languages, designed for fully-open and transparent language modeling. Trained on 15T tokens.

EuroLLM-9B-2512.description: Multilingual transformer supporting 34 languages, an enhanced version of EuroLLM-9B with long-context extension.

EuroLLM-22B-2512.description: Multilingual transformer trained on 4 trillion tokens across EU languages. Features Grouped Query Attention and 32k token context window.

gemma-3-1b-pt.description: From Google's Gemma 3 family. Supports 140+ languages.

gemma-3-4b-pt.description: From Google's Gemma 3 family. Supports 140+ languages.

gemma-3-12b-pt.description: Multimodal model from Google trained on 12 trillion tokens. Supports 140+ languages with text and image input.

gemma-3-27b-pt.description: Multimodal model from Google trained on 14 trillion tokens. Supports text and image understanding with 128k context window.

Llama-3.2-1B.description: Lightweight multilingual language model from Meta supporting 8 languages. Trained on up to 9T tokens with knowledge distillation from Llama 3.1 8B/70B. 128k context length.

Llama-3.2-3B.description: Lightweight multilingual language model from Meta supporting 8 languages. Trained on up to 9T tokens with knowledge distillation from Llama 3.1 8B/70B. 128k context length.

Llama-3.1-8B.description: Multilingual language model from Meta supporting 8 languages. Trained on 15T+ tokens with 128k context length.

Llama-3.1-70B.description: Multilingual language model from Meta supporting 8 languages. Trained on 15T+ tokens with 128k context length.

Mistral-7B-v0.1.description: Generative text model from Mistral AI that uses Grouped-Query Attention and Sliding-Window Attention.

Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407.description: Pretrained generative text model trained jointly by Mistral AI and NVIDIA. Features 128k context window and multilingual support.

Ministral-3-3B-Base-2512-Llamafied-TextO.description: Text-only language model component of Mistral AI's Ministral 3 (3B) multimodal model, converted to Llama format.

Ministral-3-8B-Base-2512-Llamafied-TextO.description: Text-only language model component of Mistral AI's Ministral 3 (9B) multimodal model, converted to Llama format.

Ministral-3-14B-Base-2512-Llamafied-Text.description: Text-only language model component of Mistral AI's Ministral 3 (14B) multimodal model, converted to Llama format.

Mistral-Small-24B-Base-2501.description: Pretrained base language model from Mistral AI with 24B parameters. Supports multilingual text with a 32k context window.

Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Base-2503-textonly.description: The improved v2503 of Mistral Small – a pretrained base language model from Mistral AI with 24B parameters. Supports multilingual text with a 32k context window.

Qwen2.5-32B.description: Base language model from Qwen. Multilingual with 29 language support.

Qwen2.5-72B.description: Base language model from Qwen. Multilingual with 29 language support.

Qwen3-1.7B-Base.description: Base language model from Qwen. Multilingual with 100+ language support.

Qwen3-4B-Base.description: Base language model from Qwen. Multilingual with 100+ language support.

Qwen3-8B-Base.description: Base language model from Qwen. Multilingual with 100+ language support.

Qwen3-14B-Base.description: Base language model from Qwen. Multilingual with 100+ language support.

AI-Sweden-Models-Llama-3-8B.description: Model based on Llama 3 architecture, continually-trained on Swedish and Nordic data by AI Sweden.

gpt-sw3-1.3b.description: Autoregressive language model trained on Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Icelandic, English, and programming code. Developed by AI Sweden and RISE.

gpt-sw3-6.7b-v2.description: Autoregressive language model trained on Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Icelandic, English, and programming code. Developed by AI Sweden and RISE.

gpt-sw3-20b.description: Autoregressive language model trained on Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Icelandic, English, and programming code. Developed by AI Sweden and RISE.

gpt-sw3-40b.description: Autoregressive language model trained on Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Icelandic, English, and programming code. Developed by AI Sweden and RISE.

Viking-7B.description: Open language model for Nordic languages developed by SILO AI. Supports Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Icelandic, and English.

Viking-13B.description: Open language model for Nordic languages developed by SILO AI (named 13B after its architecture). Supports Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Icelandic, and English.

Viking-33B.description: Open language model for Nordic languages developed by SILO AI. Supports Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Icelandic, and English.

Poro-34B.description: Open language model for Finnish, English, and code, developed by SILO AI in collaboration with TurkuNLP and the University of Edinburgh.

dfm-decoder-open-v0-7b-pt.description: Base language model continually pre-trained from Comma v0.1 on 30B tokens of Danish and English data. Developed by Danish Foundation Models with fully open training data, code, and weights.

normistral-11b-thinking-full.description: Instruction-tuned Norwegian language model with reasoning capabilities, fine-tuned from NorMistral 11B using SFT and reinforcement learning (d-RLAIF). Supports reasoning with <think> tokens.

normistral-11b-thinking-base-like.description: Same model as NorMistral 11B Thinking, but evaluated as a base model without chat template or reasoning traces.

borealis-1b-instruct-preview.description: Norwegian instruction-tuned preview model fine-tuned from Gemma3 1B IT by the National Library of Norway (NbAiLab). Designed for Norwegian-centric assistant-style tasks.

borealis-4b-instruct-preview.description: Norwegian instruction-tuned preview model fine-tuned from Gemma3 4B IT by the National Library of Norway (NbAiLab). Designed for Norwegian-centric assistant-style tasks.

borealis-12b-instruct-preview.description: Norwegian instruction-tuned preview model fine-tuned from Gemma3 12B IT by the National Library of Norway (NbAiLab). Designed for Norwegian-centric assistant-style tasks.

borealis-27b-instruct-preview.description: Norwegian instruction-tuned preview model fine-tuned from Gemma3 27B IT by the National Library of Norway (NbAiLab). Designed for Norwegian-centric assistant-style tasks.

nb-notram-llama-3.2-1b-instruct.description: Norwegian instruction-tuned model fine-tuned from Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct by the National Library of Norway. Trained on publicly available data using SFT and DPO.

nb-notram-llama-3.2-3b-instruct.description: Norwegian instruction-tuned model fine-tuned from Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct by the National Library of Norway. Trained on publicly available data using SFT and DPO.

nb-notram-llama-3.1-8b-instruct.description: Norwegian instruction-tuned model fine-tuned from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct by the National Library of Norway. Trained on publicly available data using SFT and DPO.

nb-notram-llama-3.3-70b-instruct.description: Norwegian instruction-tuned model fine-tuned from Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct by the National Library of Norway. Trained on publicly available data using SFT and DPO.

gemma-3-1b-it.description: Instruction-tuned model from Google's Gemma 3 family. Supports 140+ languages.

gemma-3-4b-it-full.description: Instruction-tuned model from Google's Gemma 3 family. Supports 140+ languages.

gemma-3-12b-it-full.description: Instruction-tuned multimodal model from Google's Gemma 3 family. Supports 140+ languages with text and image input.

gemma-3-27b-it.description: Instruction-tuned multimodal model from Google's Gemma 3 family. Supports 140+ languages with 128k context window.

Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct.description: Instruction-tuned lightweight multilingual language model from Meta supporting 8 languages. 128k context length.

Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-full.description: Instruction-tuned lightweight multilingual language model from Meta supporting 8 languages. 128k context length.

Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-full.description: Instruction-tuned multilingual language model from Meta supporting 8 languages. 128k context length.

Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-full.description: Instruction-tuned multilingual language model from Meta. 128k context length.
